create.name: Alexandra Wenman
create.bio:
Alexandra Wenman is a British angel communicator, channel and author who teaches angelic healing, light language and spiritual alchemy. She began training in complementary therapies in 2007 and started seeing clients a few years later while working as editor of Prediction, the UK holistic magazine. She developed Archangel Alchemy, an angelic energy healing practice, and Precious Wisdom, a channelled healing system she teaches in tiered workshops, and she trained in Angelic Reiki.

Her teaching covers working with the archangels and their symbols, channelling, access to the soul's records, sacred geometry, crystals and Earth gridwork at sacred sites. She teaches live online classes, in-person workshops and pilgrimages, and self-paced courses on The Shift Network, including Archangel Healing Activations and Light Language of the Angelic Realms. Since 2017 she has hosted a YouTube interview show, now called Divine Is The New Normal. Her books include Archangel Alchemy Healing, the Archangel Fire Oracle and the Water Alchemy Oracle, alongside two collections of poetry.

books.title: Archangel Alchemy Healing: The Celestial Science in the Vibration of the Universe
books.author: Alexandra Wenman
books.description: A guide to Archangel Alchemy, the angelic energy practice channelled through Alexandra Wenman. It explains the hierarchy of the archangels, light language and its symbols, and sets out the practice's invocations, meditations and attunements, including hands-on, distance and Earth work.

books.title: Archangel Fire Oracle
books.author: Alexandra Wenman
books.description: A 40-card oracle deck and guidebook for working with the archangels, illustrated by Aveliya Savina. Each card carries a message and practice for connecting with an angelic quality.

books.title: Water Alchemy Oracle: A 40-Card Deck and Guidebook
books.author: Alexandra Wenman
books.description: An oracle deck and guidebook built around the element of water, with art by Aveliya Savina. The cards draw on water's symbolism, spirits and sacred sites for reflection and guidance.

courses.title: The Diamond Earth Lightkeeper
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course on attuning to the Earth's energy field. It covers planetary gridwork, sacred sites and ley lines, star portal work and angelic attunements.

courses.title: Light Language of the Angelic Realms
courses.description: A fourteen-module self-paced course on expressing light language through voice, writing, movement and art. It works with sigils, sacred geometry, sound and mudra alongside the archangels, and includes the Archangel Healing Activations programme.

courses.title: Archangel Healing Activations
courses.description: A seven-module self-paced video course pairing one archangel with one sacred geometry symbol in each module. It teaches ways to connect with the archangels for resilience and emotional balance.

courses.title: Who Am I? Divine Integration Video Course
courses.description: A video e-course of over five hours that moves through thirteen levels of consciousness. It includes guided meditations, channelled messages and exercises on soul purpose, guides and energy clearing.

courses.title: Precious Wisdom Alchemy
courses.description: Alexandra's channelled energy healing system taught in three levels, from a two-day introductory workshop to an advanced qualification. It works with sacred symbols, angels and guides and the levels of consciousness.
courses.price: £222 GBP (Level One); £333 GBP (Levels Two and Three)

courses.title: Become a Divine Channel
courses.description: A live online course on Zoom, offered as a one-day introduction or a longer multi-week course. It teaches how to tune into other realms, set energetic boundaries and practise channelling in a group.

courses.title: Lightworkers Healing and Support Circle
courses.description: A monthly live circle on the first Friday of each month, booked through Eventbrite. Each evening includes channelled guidance and guided processes from the angelic realms.

courses.title: Divine Origins Egypt Pilgrimage
courses.description: A fourteen-day spiritual pilgrimage through ancient Egypt, led with Lorraine Flaherty. It visits temples and sacred sites with guided meditations, activations and teaching on Egyptian wisdom.

free_resources.title: Soul Blueprint: Four Free Gifts
free_resources.description: A free sign-up bundle with a PDF clearing and protection ritual and three recorded meditation journeys. These include a loving kindness meditation and a channelled message from Mary, Queen of Angels.
